the cascaded multilevel inverter can be used in the PV system to improve the power quality and the RTDS can be applied to simulate the high penetration multiple PV system.
a PV system with energy storage is successfully implemented in RTDS, and the system model is verified by Matlab/Simulik+PSIM results.

the cascaded-multilevel converter can provide a flexible solution for PV system with energy storage integration and RTDS is an effective platform to study the high-penetration PV system with energy storages.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel RTDS model for a high-penetration PV system integrated with energy storage elements.
the modeling and simulation of a novel battery-PV system with the cascaded multilevel inverter in RTDS.
the development of the RTDS model of a battery-integrated PV power system, which can be used as the partial work for the HIL study of high-penetrated multiple PV systems.

this paper is the first time to implement a PV system integrated with ESEs in Real Time Digital Simulator.
this work is a successful step towards future HIL simulation of high penetration multiple PV systems with battery storage elements.
the proposed RTDS model can be used to simulate a battery integrated PV system with cascaded-multilevel converter.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the system is successfully built in RTDS.

RTDS is a powerful tool to study the power electronic systems in the large-scale grid environment, which could be used to verify the control strategies and system performance before the hardware-in-loop implementation.
this paper provides a feasible way to realize a battery-integrated PV power system with cascaded-multilevel inverters in RTDS and the model is validated.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cascaded multilevel inverter can be used as the power electronics converter in a PV system with energy storage, which is a promising solution for high penetration PV application.
the proposed RTDS simulation platform can provide a good reference and support for the hardware-in-the-loop test of high penetration PV system in the future.
it provides a platform to test and evaluate the performance of the PV system with energy storage for future high penetration application.
